props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: size
props.description: Deprecated legacy size prop. ColorSlider uses the Spectrum 2 fixed track size.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Deprecated legacy value visibility prop. Spectrum 2 shows horizontal output.

props.name: contextualHelp
props.description: Contextual help shown next to the visible label.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: id
props.description: Element id for the slider track group.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the color changes.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of element that describes the slider.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: ID of element that provides detailed information about the slider.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the slider.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels the slider.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the slider is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description: Associated form owner for the hidden range input.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the hidden range input.

props.name: value
props.description: The current color value (controlled).

props.name: orientation
props.description: The slider orientation.

props.name: label
props.description: A visible label for the slider.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default color value (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Handler called when dragging ends.

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: Color space used for channel values.

props.name: channel
props.description: The color channel to control.

props.name: channelName
props.description: Localized channel name.
